plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Switch and settings for the Model Context Protocol bridge (oxelis-host.exe). While this plugin is installed and enabled, AI assistants such as Claude Desktop may use the tools named in its allowed_tools setting to read and translate on-screen text. Screenshots are disabled unless 'screenshot' is added to allowed_tools.
plugins.name: MCP server

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Panel beside the selection showing its dimensions and, after recognition, the number of lines, words and characters.
plugins.name: Selection statistics

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Adds two buttons for recognized text, one that copies it as a single paragraph and one that copies it without blank lines, and removes trailing whitespace from each recognized line.
plugins.name: Text tools

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Amber selection frame and a dark warm toolbar. The toolbar is placed above the selection when space permits.
plugins.name: Amber theme

plugins.author: Oxelis

credits.license: Web service, subject to the provider's terms of use
credits.name: DeepL API

plugins.description: Translation through the DeepL API (free or pro key). The key is entered in the plugin settings.
plugins.name: DeepL

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Offline translation through MTranServer (https://github.com/xxnuo/MTranServer), which uses Bergamot models from Firefox Translations and is operated by the user, by default at http://localhost:8989. All processing stays on the local machine. The plugin can reach only the address entered in its settings.
plugins.name: MTranServer (local server)

plugins.author: Oxelis

credits.license: Web service, subject to the provider's terms of use
credits.name: MyMemory

plugins.description: Translation through the public MyMemory API. No key is required; the service limits use to approximately 5,000 characters per day per address, and quality is lower than that of the larger engines.
plugins.name: MyMemory

plugins.author: Oxelis

credits.license: Interface specification; the server in use is subject to its own terms
credits.name: OpenAI API (chat completions)

plugins.description: Translation with a large language model behind an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API, such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, or a model served locally (for example Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1, which needs no key and works offline). The plugin can reach only the address entered in its settings.
plugins.name: OpenAI-compatible chat API
